text:
nina: Quick check: ordering of actions in the trace toolbar. Should 'Copy ID' be primary (leftmost) action, then 'Share permalink', then kebab with Export/Download? Mock: https://www.figma.com/file/toolbar-ordering

omar: I vote Copy first. It's the most common for support/debugging. Share permalink second. Kebab for everything else reduces clutter.

frank: Also think about failure states: if navigator.clipboard fails (older browsers or blocked), show a fallback UI that selects the full ID so users can Cmd/Ctrl+C manually and announce that to SRs. Don't assume clipboard always works.

jess: Accessibility: Copy must have aria-label="Copy correlation ID". When copy succeeds fire a polite announcement: role=status + aria-live=polite -> "Correlation ID copied to clipboard." If copy fails, announce "Copy failed. Press Ctrl/C to copy the ID."

nina: Good. Also: analytics privacy question  we track copy events, should we include the full corr id in event props? Security says no. Track trace_id hashed or tokenized only (e.g., last 8 chars), or better: boolean success + masked_id prop.

omar: Agree. Event spec: trace.copy_attempt (props: trace_id_masked, view:detail|list, method:button|shortcut|select, success:true|false). No full ids in logs.

frank: Keyboard shortcut idea: when corr-id element is focused, allow Cmd/Ctrl+C to copy only that element (not global). But we must avoid overriding normal copy when focus is in an input. Only intercept if focusedElement has attribute data-trace-id.

jess: Tooltip & hint: show "Press C to copy" on hover/focus but ensure platform glyphs switch (Cmd vs Ctrl). For SRs, tooltip isn't enough; provide an explicit button in the DOM order after the ID.

nina: UX: For very long IDs, show truncated pill with ellipsis in lists. Clicking copy should reveal a temporary overlay with full ID for selection if clipboard is blocked. On detail page show full selectable text.

omar: Export formats: JSON, CSV, and gzipped JSON for big exports. Put export in kebab but surface 'Download JSON' as first kebab item for discoverability. Also provide a sticky bulk export CTA when multiple traces are selected.

frank: Error handling microcopy: "Could not copy ID. Click to select the full ID." Keep messages short and actionable. For download errors: "Export failed. Try again or contact support."

jess: Focus management: after opening kebab menu, trap focus inside menu; closing returns focus to the kebab button. For copy action, focus should remain on the copy button and the toast should not steal focus.

a11y-bot: Created tickets: D-4010 (Toolbar action ordering), D-4011 (Clipboard fallback & overlay), D-4012 (Analytics masking for copy), D-4013 (Keyboard shortcut safe-intercept) :white_check_mark:

nina: Action items: nina update Figma to make Copy primary + Share secondary + kebab for exports, due Mon; omar prototype clipboard fallback overlay & shortcut behavior by Wed; frank draft analytics spec with masked_id and success flag by Thu; jess write accessibility checklist + toast wording and test notes by Thu.

omar: I'll also add automated test cases for clipboard unavailable scenarios and mobile long-press behavior.

jess: I'll run VoiceOver & NVDA checks once prototype is ready.

nina: Thanks team 44d closing thread, will attach updated mock links when ready.
